description: This file defines the implementation of the CrosvmBuilder class, which constructs command-line invocations for the crosvm hypervisor, including configuration of CPUs, serial devices, disks, network interfaces, and control sockets.

classes.name: CrosvmBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing crosvm command-line invocations with various configuration options.

methods.name: CrosvmBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the command with 'crosvm'.

methods.name: ApplyProcessRestarter
methods.description: Configures the command to restart the process with specified binary, argument, and exit code.

methods.name: AddControlSocket
methods.description: Adds a control socket parameter and sets up a stopper command for stopping the VM.

methods.name: AddCpus
methods.description: Adds CPU configuration either from a JSON file or a specified number of CPUs.

methods.name: AddCpus (overload)
methods.description: Adds CPU configuration from a JSON object.

methods.name: AddCpus (size_t)
methods.description: Adds a specified number of CPUs.

methods.name: AddHvcSink
methods.description: Adds a virtual serial sink device.

methods.name: AddHvcReadOnly
methods.description: Adds a read-only serial device with a specified output path.

methods.name: AddHvcReadWrite
methods.description: Adds a serial device with specified output and input paths.

methods.name: AddHvcSocket
methods.description: Adds a UNIX socket serial device.

methods.name: AddKvmPath
methods.description: Specifies the KVM hypervisor device path.

methods.name: AddReadOnlyDisk
methods.description: Adds a read-only disk image.

methods.name: AddReadWriteDisk
methods.description: Adds a read-write disk image.

methods.name: AddSerialSink
methods.description: Adds a serial sink device.

methods.name: AddSerialConsoleReadOnly
methods.description: Adds a serial console device in read-only mode.

methods.name: AddSerialConsoleReadWrite
methods.description: Adds a serial console device with read-write access.

methods.name: AddSerial
methods.description: Adds a serial device with specified output and input paths.

methods.name: AddTap
methods.description: Adds a TAP network interface with optional MAC and PCI address (Linux only).

methods.name: AddVhostUser
methods.description: Adds a vhost-user socket device.

methods.name: HvcNum
methods.description: Returns the current number of serial devices.

methods.name: Cmd
methods.description: Returns a reference to the internal command object.
